page.overview:
Who is Kenton Motorize?

Darlington Motorize (Younger sister) Harriet Motorize (Mother) Ben Motorize (Father) William Cardinal (Brother-in-law)|noveldebut=JORGE JOESTAR Chapter 7: Airplanes|race=Human (formerly) Zombie|status=Deceased|cod=Murdered by Antonio Torres|namesake= ( album)

Kenton has a slim build. She has short, blonde hair in a bob cut style with her bangs swept to the side. She is seen wearing suspenders with her sleeves rolled up.

Kenton is a kind young girl, described to always smile, and never hid her feelings away. She is described to be fun to have around and is a good friend to Jorge, as she inspires him to build planes.
